lessons.claim: By how many times a block SEM underestimates the scatter between realizations **differs per observable and per condition** -- it must not be cited as a single factor. In the same run set (trap-drag, gv=24.21), dU/particle gave 2.35x and F_drag gave 1.37x. Across the whole v-sweep, F_drag's factor is 1.09~2.28x (median 1.63) and grows with the velocity (1.1 at low speed → 2.28 at high). The widely cited 2.35 is the dU/particle value and was being used as it stood for the drag-force error too. The lesson: measure the underestimation factor on the very observable you are going to cite.
